choice: A smaller lift keeps product text steady while acknowledging interaction.
limit: Hover is supplemental; touch users can activate the same native button.

choice: A shorter, smaller press separates immediate feedback from the save result.
limit: The demo saves no server data. Press feedback does not mean saving succeeded.

request.zh-CN: 一个接一个出现，别拖太久
request.en: Reveal one by one without excessive delay

choice: Shorter delays keep the complete list available sooner.
limit: Visual order follows DOM order; animation is not required to understand the list.

request.en: A little warm light and a small lift

choice: Lower opacity keeps text contrast and limits visual distraction.
limit: A CSS fallback is approximate and must be identified; touch does not enable hover glow.

request.en: A ripple at the click position

choice: A shorter ripple makes repeated actions easier to distinguish.
limit: The ripple signals an input action, not a successful server response.

request.zh-CN: 结果及时出现，保留自然顺序
request.en: Show results promptly in natural order

choice: A low travel distance and short delay avoid slowing down repeated searches.
limit: List binding uses a fixed child snapshot; rebind after structural changes.

request.zh-CN: 在原有按钮上增加轻微反馈
request.en: Add subtle feedback to the existing button

choice: The hook binds to the existing element instead of replacing business markup.
limit: React 18/19 client integration; this case does not certify every SSR framework.

request.zh-CN: 沿用宿主布局，只增加暖光
request.en: Keep the host layout and add warm light

choice: Zero lift leaves host geometry and its original transform in control.
limit: The light renderer adds a child layer; inspect host stacking and overflow before integration.
